https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markokr/rarfile/master/test/files/seektest.rar

Retrieved and compared with the existing selftest download on 2026-10-22.
Size: 2253 bytes.
SHA256: `8143d03362e40e3abd0857b4110a1819071426f7c3c59f32238319061104db19`.
